games.title: Heiankyo Alien
games.dev: University of Tokyo Theoretical Science Group
games.note: Made by students. Players dig holes in the streets of old Kyoto to trap aliens, then bury them.

games.title: Space Panic
games.note: The first game with ladders between walkable platforms, released months before Donkey Kong.

games.title: Chuckie Egg
games.note: Hen-House Harry collects eggs while hens chase him and a giant duck waits in a cage.

games.title: Mr. Do!
games.note: A clown digs tunnels through a cherry orchard and drops apples on chasing monsters.

games.title: Dig Dug
games.note: You defeat monsters by inflating them until they pop, or by dropping rocks on them.

games.title: Bomberman
games.note: Released in Europe on the ZX Spectrum under the name Eric and the Floaters.

games.title: The Pit
games.note: A British digging game released by Zilec in the UK, Taito in Japan and Centuri in North America.

games.title: Boulder Dash
games.dev: Peter Liepa & Chris Gray (First Star Software)
games.note: Rockford digs for diamonds while boulders fall by simple physics rules, starting a rocks-and-diamonds sub-genre.

games.title: Repton
games.note: A rocks-and-diamonds puzzle game for the BBC Micro and Acorn Electron.

games.title: Miner 2049er
games.note: Bounty Bob must walk over every section of floor in each mine station to claim it.

games.title: Jumpman
games.note: Thirty levels of defusing bombs among ladders, ropes and hazards.

games.title: Rocky's Boots
games.note: An educational game where players wire up logic gates to build working machines.

games.title: Pitfall!
games.note: Pitfall Harry is called the first popular video game character created for a home console.

games.title: Track & Field
games.note: Players sprint by hammering two run buttons as fast as they can.

games.title: Pac-Land
games.note: Based on the Hanna-Barbera Pac-Man cartoon, with running controlled by tapping buttons.

games.title: Wonder Boy
games.note: A caveboy runs and jumps across islands while a vitality meter drains unless he eats fruit.

games.title: Adventure Island
games.note: Hudson's adaptation of Wonder Boy, starring Master Higgins, who was modeled on Hudson spokesman Takahashi Meijin.

games.title: Shantae
games.note: A half-genie hero who whips enemies with her hair, released late in the Game Boy Color's life.

games.title: Alex Kidd in Miracle World
games.note: Bosses are settled with rock-paper-scissors matches. Later Master System II consoles had it built in.

games.title: Karate Champ
games.note: Each player used two joysticks and no buttons. A later edition let two people fight each other.

games.title: Yie Ar Kung-Fu
games.note: The hero Oolong faces a line of opponents, each with a different weapon or fighting style.

games.title: The Way of the Exploding Fist
games.note: Made by Beam Software in Melbourne and published by Melbourne House.

games.title: International Karate
games.note: Data East sued over its US release, claiming it copied Karate Champ. The appeals court sided with Epyx.

games.title: Nürburgring 1
games.note: A German first-person racing game named after the Nürburgring circuit.

games.title: Night Driver
games.note: One of the first first-person racing games. The road is shown only as rows of moving posts.

games.title: F-1 (Namco)
games.note: An electro-mechanical racing cabinet. Its designer later worked on Pole Position.

games.title: Pole Position
games.note: The first racing game based on a real circuit, Fuji Speedway, and the first with a qualifying lap.

games.title: Hang-On
games.note: Players steered by leaning a full-size motorbike in the deluxe cabinet.

games.title: Frogger
games.note: Players guide frogs across a busy road and a river of floating logs and turtles.

games.title: Crossy Road
games.note: Released free in November 2014 by Australian studio Hipster Whale, with optional character purchases.

games.title: Blockade
games.note: Two players steer lines that grow behind them and try not to crash: the first snake game.

games.title: Tron
games.note: Based on the Disney film, with four mini-games including the light cycle race.

games.title: Spy Hunter
games.note: Uses the Peter Gunn theme because a James Bond license fell through.

games.title: Snake (Nokia)
games.note: Preinstalled on Nokia phones, starting with the Nokia 6110.
